aToB.memory: Dorian has only dealt with Headmistress Sterling occasionally over Starlight Tower housing paperwork and spirit-charter registrations, yet he respects her quiet, unyielding poise above almost any authority figure on campus. Around her serene dignity, even his dry sarcasm settles into polite formality.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Dorian wants to greet Headmistress Sterling respectfully when crossing paths in the Grand Athenaeum, assure her crisply that Starlight Tower's newest suite pairing is running peacefully, and make a steady impression.

bToA.memory: Aurelia sees right past Dorian's severe gothic coat to the calm, conscientious spirit-diplomat underneath—someone who never chases flashy applause and quietly respects institutional balance. She felt genuinely reassured knowing Leo Vance would share a Starlight Tower suite with someone so level-headed.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Aurelia wants to exchange a brief, warm greeting with Dorian in the Grand Athenaeum, commend his quiet steadiness in Starlight Tower, and express calm confidence in his helping Leo adjust to Yozakura.
